name: Day Camps@The J (Summer@The J)
description_short: Day camp on the Stamford JCC's 15-acre campus for children age 3 through grade 8, grouped as Chaverim (ages 3-4), Bonim (K-2), Tzofim (3-5) and Na'arim (6-8). Campers swim twice a day in a heated indoor pool and do sports, STEAM, zip-lining, rock climbing, archery, boating and fishing on the camp lake, with Jewish values and Shabbat woven in. Enrollment is a 2-week minimum.

sources.note: Day Camps@The J page: age groups Chaverim 3-4, Bonim K-2, Tzofim 3-5, Na'arim 6-8; Jewish values woven into every day; twice-daily swim.
Day camp experience page: electives, facilities (lake with boating and fishing, zip-lines, archery range, 25-meter indoor pool).

2027 early-bird rates, valid through 12/15/26. Prices are totals for 2 to 8 weeks (2-week minimum, no 1-week option): lowest $1,425 (2 weeks, member), highest $7,445 (8 weeks, community rate). Weeks start 6/21, 6/28, 7/6, 7/12, 7/19, 7/26, 8/2, 8/9; season June 21-August 13, so each week ends Friday. Deposit $300 members / $400 community.

source.title: The Stamford JCC - Summer at The J
